card.name: Odd split pieces inside medical terms
card.fires_on: Short word pieces that start or sit inside a split term, such as the 's' of 'pre-specified', 'AU' in AUC(TAU), the 's' of salmeterol, and the 'S' of µSv. Also fires on 'presence' in 'presence of HBV'.

modes.label: Split 's' in pre-specified
modes.description: The 's' piece after 'pre-' in 'pre-specified' risk margin or objective.

modes.label: AUC(TAU) piece
modes.description: The 'AU' piece inside AUC(TAU) in pharmacokinetic table footnotes.
modes.example: AUC = AUC(T<<AU>>) for drugs given in multiple doses.

modes.label: Other split pieces
modes.description: The first letter of a drug or unit name when it is split off, as in salmeterol or µSv.
